                                                                            ---[ {3} Vis Comica ]---

   Hehe... I think I made it!
   Stylish, great response [imo, try some music with larger dynamic          changes], nice movements, just cool [a little slow though].
   And I learned another easy way to get cool blending colors: fade-       outs!

   Anyway, credit goes to 2serious for the bumping movement solution    I took from his flash tutorial and rewrote for avs.

   You could playback "Eye of the tiger" along with this, hehe.
   But it looks also cool with ambient music!
